The unidentified '''[[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]''' worked as an exotic dancer during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] at [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] visited the bar during their investigation into the whereabouts of a young [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], the unidentified Twi'lek's performance was being watched by a [[Unidentified Rodian (Moshi Bar)/Legends|male Rodian]] and a [[Unidentified Quarren (Moshi Bar)/Legends|male Quarren]] who were arguing with each other over which one of them the Twi'lek would prefer. When Ahsoka was caught eavesdropping, the Twi'lek&mdash;along with the other bar patrons&mdash;drew a small and surprisingly well hidden [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. However, Ahsoka's quick thinking allowed the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and Plo Koon to safely leave the establishment.<ref name="Lethal" />
